scope: mobile player surface redesign and narrative variation boundary
mobile_changes: PlayPage keeps one main history scroll and places current scene, operation status, and choices/free-action controls in a bottom action dock.
New successful Run updates auto-scroll to the latest content; upward scrolling is reserved for history.
Persistent state is exposed in a collapsible 当前状态 panel.
state_feedback and turn records are grouped in a collapsible 事件与行动记录 panel instead of being mixed into narrative cards.
Completed Runs keep the formal ending summary in the history surface so the bottom action dock cannot obscure it.

verification.manual_surface: new Run opening visibly showed current-scene dock with opening narrative and choice buttons; existing worlds and local model profiles were preserved

plot_boundary.rules: authored deterministic chapter/choice/effect/ending graph in backend narrative.py
plot_boundary.opening: deterministic from world definition, hero, first location, first character and lore
plot_boundary.prose: model-generated when a profile is configured; deterministic template fallback without a model
plot_boundary.replay_behavior: same world version plus same choice sequence produces the same structure/effects/ending; prose wording may vary with the model
plot_boundary.gap: there is no per-Run seed, alternate scene pack, or variation prompt in the current contract, so repeated runs can feel substantially identical
plot_boundary.recommendation: preserve Python determinism for rules, then add an explicit per-Run variation contract (seed plus authored opening/scene variants) before claiming materially different replays

not_claimed: This is not a physical Android A-F/30-turn acceptance run.
No plot randomization was introduced in this phase; product semantics need to distinguish replayable canonical routes from intentionally varied replays.
